title: The ‘Sweetest’ Holiday Hideaways
summary: For those with a sweet tooth, Hilton hotels offer tempting reasons to plan a holiday getaway. Discover the sweetest holiday destinations.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article

From chocolate‑covered towns and decadent seasonal displays to indulgent spa experiences, discover delicious destinations that make holiday travel even sweeter


- **Discover some of the sweetest holiday destinations, where beloved local confections, chocolate-inspired experiences and festive traditions create unforgettable seasonal getaways.**
- **Explore Pennsylvania’s rich chocolate-making heritage, from the confectionery capital of Hershey to a former chocolate factory transformed into a charming boutique hotel.**
- **Experience the magic of the holidays at Hilton Americas-Houston, home to an extraordinary 1,800-pound chocolate display, thousands of twinkling lights and festive family activities.**
- **From sipping cocoa beside the water in Orlando to embracing ancient cacao traditions in Mexico and Colombia, Hilton offers deliciously different ways to celebrate the season.**


The holidays are the perfect excuse to indulge a little. From decadent chocolates and freshly baked cookies to beloved confections with recipes passed down through generations, the world’s most iconic sweet treats have a special way of making the season feel even more magical. And all around the globe, delectable destinations are putting their own drool-worthy spin on holiday traditions, inviting travelers to savor the season one irresistible bite at a time.


For those with a sweet tooth, Hilton hotels offer plenty of tempting reasons to plan a holiday getaway. Travelers can savor charming towns steeped in chocolate-making history, larger-than-life edible masterpieces, creative cocoa-inspired activities and indulgent wellness experiences that celebrate the rich heritage of cacao. So, whether hungry jetsetters are craving a nostalgic winter escape or a sun-soaked holiday retreat, these mouth-watering destinations promise to make the sweetest time of year even more irresistible.


## Hershey, Pennsylvania


### A Holiday Rich in Chocolate History


For chocolate lovers, few destinations are as enticing as Hershey, Pennsylvania. Known for its longstanding confectionery heritage, this charming town takes on an especially festive glow during the holidays, when twinkling lights, seasonal attractions and the tempting scent of chocolate create a setting that delights the senses.


Tru by Hilton Hershey Chocolate Avenue - Lobby


At[Tru by Hilton Hershey Chocolate Avenue](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/mdthcru-tru-hershey-chocolate-avenue/) , even breakfast can satisfy a sweet tooth. Guests can start the day at Tru’s complimentary Top It Breakfast Bar, dressing up hot, fresh pancakes from the hotel’s signature automatic pancake maker with sweet toppings for a morning treat all their own. Before heading out to explore, travelers can find inspiration on the hotel’s Truly Local wall, featuring team member recommendations for nearby restaurants, attractions and local favorites.


Visitors can embrace the magic of the season with chocolate-inspired activities and opportunities to sample the area’s most iconic sweet treats before venturing beyond Hershey to explore the region's equally delightful small towns. Among them is Lititz, which offers its own delicious connection to Pennsylvania's confectionery past.


The Wilbur Lititz, Tapestry Collection by Hilton - Front Desk


Once home to a bustling chocolate factory, the historic Wilbur Chocolate Company building has been reimagined as[The Wilbur Lititz, Tapestry Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/lnscsup-the-wilbur-lititz/) , a boutique hotel that offers modern comfort with a ton of industrial character. Original architectural details pay homage to the building's sweet beginnings, while its location in the heart of downtown Lititz places guests within easy reach of charming shops, local bakeries, inviting cafés and a storied chocolate museum, located right next door.


During the holidays, the town's picturesque streets and festive atmosphere make it an ideal destination for travelers seeking a nostalgic escape, with a little chocolate history on the side.


## Tulum, Mexico


### Discover the Ancient Traditions of Cacao


For travelers interested in the story behind their favorite sweet indulgence, Tulum offers a fascinating journey into cacao's ancient roots. Long before chocolate became synonymous with holiday treats, cacao held deep cultural and ceremonial significance for ancient Mesoamerican civilizations. Today, visitors to Mexico's Riviera Maya can discover a different side of this beloved ingredient through an immersive experience at[Conrad Tulum Riviera Maya, an All-Inclusive Experience](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/cuncici-conrad-tulum-riviera-maya/) .


Conrad Tulum Riviera Maya, an All-Inclusive Experience - Conrad Spa Tulum


The resort's Cacao Ceremony celebrates the cultural heritage of cacao, inviting participants to gather in a circle for a guided ritual of reflection, gratitude and intention-setting. Drawing on traditions passed down through generations, the experience incorporates a ceremonial presentation of cacao to the four cardinal directions, personal offerings, music and movement.


Guests are also invited to enjoy cacao prepared in a traditional style with honey sourced from the Mayan region, while cocoa butter adds a soothing element to the experience. It's a meaningful alternative to the usual holiday indulgence, offering travelers an opportunity to connect with the region's cultural traditions.


And if that’s not sweet enough, the region's other culinary traditions offer plenty to satisfy any palate. One treat worth seeking out is the marquesita, a beloved Yucatán specialty made from a thin, crispy rolled crepe filled with chocolate, caramel or other sweet toppings, often paired with salty Edam cheese. The unexpected combination of sweet and savory flavors makes for an irresistible taste that’s the perfect addition to any holiday feast.


## Orlando, Florida


### Hot Cocoa with a Creative Twist


When it comes to sunny hideaways where holiday warmth is always on the menu, Orlando is a true crowd pleaser. Here, travelers can trade traditional winter scenery for sunshine and sparkling waterfront views while indulging in one of the season's most comforting treats at[Conrad Orlando](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/orlcici-conrad-orlando/) as the hotel's Cocoa and Canvas experience puts a creative spin on a beloved holiday beverage, inviting guests to sip hot chocolate while participating in a guided, step-by-step seasonal painting class by the water.


Conrad Orlando - Evermore Bay with Holiday Decorations


With tranquil surroundings, a little artistic inspiration and a delicious drink in hand, it's a welcome opportunity to slow down amid the holiday bustle while creating a festive masterpiece. And this experience is just one of many ways to unwind at this luxury waterside retreat, which is set within the sprawling Evermore Orlando Resort. Surrounded by impossibly turquoise waters, guests can spend their days lounging along the sandy shores of Evermore Bay, taking a dip in the expansive pool or enjoying rejuvenating spa experiences and diverse dining options.


It's a luxurious escape that’s situated near Central Florida's world-famous theme parks and attractions, making it easy for families to spend the season together in an all-ages hotspot that’s overflowing with festive fun that’s sure to delight.


## Cartagena, Colombia


### A Sweet Escape for the Senses


Who says chocolate is just for eating? In Cartagena, Colombia, travelers can discover other uses for this indulgent treat at[Hilton Cartagena](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/ctghihh-hilton-cartagena-hotel/) , where cacao takes center stage in a restorative spa experience inspired by two of Colombia's most celebrated ingredients: chocolate and coffee.


Hilton Cartagena Hotel - Cocoa Tribute & Massage


The Cocoa Tribute & Massage invites couples to enjoy a body exfoliation featuring cocoa granules and 100% Colombian coffee, followed by a comforting wrap of warm natural cocoa designed to moisturize the skin. A 30-minute massage with aromatic oils adds another layer of relaxation, while access to the sauna and Turkish bath rounds out this pampering experience.


For travelers looking to escape the winter chill, it's a deliciously decadent way to unwind before exploring the region’s colonial architecture, vibrant culture and tropical warmth. While visiting Cartagena's historic Walled City, be sure to head for the colorful Portal de los Dulces, which invites visitors to sample traditional Colombian confections, including cocadas, chewy coconut sweets made with sugar or panela, and alegrías, a regional specialty made with popped amaranth and sweet syrup.


## Houston, Texas


### A Holiday Masterpiece Made of Chocolate


Some holiday decorations are almost good enough to eat. And at[Hilton Americas-Houston](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/houcvhh-hilton-americas-houston/) , that sentiment takes on an entirely new meaning. Each holiday season, the hotel's soaring lobby becomes home to an extraordinary 1,800-pound chocolate masterpiece, handcrafted by Pastry Chef Mahesh Weerasinghe and his talented team. A beloved tradition since 2013, the spectacular creation features a new theme each year, combining intricate craftsmanship, internationally inspired artistry and a generous helping of holiday imagination.


Hilton Americas Houston - Lobby


And this chocolate showstopper is only the beginning. Some 80,000 sparkling lights illuminate the lobby, transforming the hotel into a festive wonderland that invites visitors to linger and soak up the seasonal magic. Families can add another memorable moment to their stay with Breakfast with Santa, offered on select weekends in December.


As part of downtown Houston's annual City Lights celebration, Hilton Americas-Houston also serves as the "Land of Sweets" stop on the holiday tour, joining a collection of festive attractions, dazzling light displays and seasonal experiences throughout the city. Sweetest of all, the chocolate display is open to the public, making it a must-see holiday attraction for hotel guests and Houston locals alike.


## All Around the World


### A Warm Welcome, Fresh from the Oven


From the chocolate-making traditions of Pennsylvania to the indulgent spa rituals of Colombia, every destination has its own delicious way of satisfying a sweet tooth. But sometimes, the sweetest part of traveling is found in the little moments that make a stay feel special.


DoubleTree by Hilton - Signature Warm Chocolate Chip Cookie


At[DoubleTree by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/doubletree-by-hilton/) hotels around the globe, one of those moments arrives at check-in, when guests are welcomed with an original, warm DoubleTree chocolate chip cookie. With more than 20 million cookies enjoyed annually using over 1.2 million pounds of chocolate chips, it's a beloved tradition that feels especially comforting during the holidays, whether after a long day of sightseeing, shopping or festive celebrations.


So, whether travelers are drawn to larger-than-life chocolate creations, cacao-inspired escapes or the simple pleasure of a freshly baked cookie, the holidays offer countless treats for the tastebuds. And all along the way, Hilton makes it easy to celebrate the sweetest time of year, one exceptional experience at a time.
